ART STYLE = the project's established Vespera standard: polished painterly 2D semi-real fantasy game splash art. Maintain it without borrowing Vespera's face, haircut, glasses, clothing or backdrop.

GARTER BELT IS A REQUIRED EXACT DETAIL: reproduce the visible narrow vertical black suspender strap from under the waist down to the top of the screen-left thigh-high stocking, the ornate black-and-gold thigh band, small jewelry attachment and hanging gold ornament. FACE: REBUILD FROM THE THREE PHOTOGRAPHS.
Keep Hi Heeya recognizable: her softly full oval cheek planes and rounded small lower jaw, large dark eyes with their actual spacing and distinctive shape, soft fairly straight eyebrows, short rounded nose, naturally full rose lips with the characteristic lower-lip contour. Use the neutral expression in IMAGE 5; mouth relaxed and closed, no tongue. Do not reuse the generic narrow pointed-chin face in either illustration. Paint her as the same adult woman in the reference photographs, translated naturally into Vespera's 2D semi-real game illustration style. No pasted photographic face. Keep the facial likeness readable at full figure scale.
The head is newly drawn, neck upright, no sideways head tilt; face turned subtly about 10–15 degrees toward screen right, eyes toward the viewer. Retain IMAGE 1's BODY pose while independently correcting the head and identity.

APPROVED WEAPONS: EXACTLY AS IN IMAGE 2.
Keep the white ceramic/black steel/pale gold back frame and red power accents, all support arms and two handles, and all SEVEN weapons:

- ONE thick cylindrical auxiliary cannon directly below that right-side energy cannon.

Do not use IMAGE 1's old all-black weapon design or its right-side Gatling. Do not delete, merge, duplicate or relocate approved weapon types. Mounting geometry may be rigidly repositioned just enough to meet the exact body pose; the approved individual weapon designs stay identical.
Each complete receiver, barrel and muzzle must stay on one continuous STRAIGHT RIGID AXIS. Rails and barrel bundles remain consistently parallel in perspective. No bowing, kinks, sagging joins or flexible guns. Weapons do not block the face, garter or thighs. All muzzle ends stay within the portrait.

NEW BACKGROUND:
Completely replace both old backdrops with a moonlit COASTAL FORTRESS GUN PLATFORM. Broad weathered dark stone beneath the same spread feet, a low fortress parapet opening onto a deep blue sea and distant cliffs, wind-driven clouds around a pale moon, subdued warm lantern light from the side. Clear large atmospheric shapes, enough open sky behind the upper arsenal. A fresh cool blue-gray night palette balanced by the guns' red cores and restrained warm edge light. No glass conservatory, indoor garden, stairs under the boots, gothic cathedral city or red flags. Light the face and clothing clearly rather than silhouetting them.

HAIR AND QUALITY:
Long dark hair with the reference woman's natural parting, softly flowing mostly behind her shoulders. Continuous smooth organic volumes, a dry soft sheen and very few fine stray hairs. No greasy locks, rope strands, layered plates, string webs, repeating shiny bands or giant windblown hair cloud. The maid headband stays.
Premium painterly 2D semi-real fantasy splash art: expressive readable face, deliberate brushwork, clean skin shading, excellent cloth/lace/metal separation. Not a photograph or glossy 3D doll. Match the exact requested costume and stance before adding detail.
One full-body exact 2:3 portrait at native 1024x1536 RGB PNG or larger exact 2:3. No words, name, rank, logo, watermark, card frame or UI.
